entities.name: Saturation gap suggests methemoglobinemia
observations: Cyanosis with SpO₂ 86% despite PaO₂ 85 mmHg suggests dyshemoglobinemia such as methemoglobinemia; confirm with co-oximetry.
Search did not establish whether this infant's methemoglobinemia is acquired from oxidant exposure or hereditary reductase deficiency.
